visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women are seated side-by-side behind a light-colored wooden table. A young man wearing a black face mask and a black T-shirt stands behind them. He holds a clear plastic cup containing a thick, yellowish liquid with dark solids. (2) The scene cuts as the women take turns tasting from three different paper cups. On-screen text labels identify brands like "DaYungs" and "Ma-Gu". The participants whisper and smile while the man gestures towards the camera with his hands. (3) The setting shifts to a tiled bathroom. A woman in a dark gray dress kneels next to a white toilet. She holds a glass of the yellowish mixture. She takes a small sip, grimaces, and immediately vomits into the toilet bowl. (4) Another woman in a white cardigan takes her turn, drinking the same mixture. She gaggs intensely and spits into the toilet. The man films himself from a high angle, pointing at the messy toilet bowl while laughing behind his mask.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A fast-paced, high-arousal male voice speaks in Mandarin over an upbeat, bouncy electronic synthesizer track. A sharp 'ding' sound effect plays when a brand name is mentioned. The vocals are clear and enunciated with high pitch variability. (2) Soft, quiet female voices converse in the background while the man continues his high-energy narration. The background music maintains a consistent tempo of about 110 BPM, featuring bright synthesizer textures and a light, repetitive drum beat. (3) The audio texture changes to a resonant, echoic environment. A sudden gagging sound from a female voice is followed by the splashing of liquid into a toilet. Loud laughter from the male speaker and high-pitched female squeals overlap. (4) Continued gagging and coughing sounds are mixed with the man's amused, somewhat distorted voice as he speaks close to the microphone. The cheerful background music persists at a constant volume, contrasting with the chaotic, low-fidelity incidental bathroom noises.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is designed for comedic entertainment, following a 'blind milk tea taste test' challenge. The narrative shifts from a standard comparison to a gross-out penalty phase where participants must drink a disgusting concoction of natto and other ingredients, leading to extreme physical reactions for humor.
